static_traits.name: Li Chen
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友和家人的关系因自我隔离而紧张；总体家庭支持，但not yet向家人分享担忧
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without以往类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly coherent logic, neutral tone, able to cooperate in exploration and planning

basic_info.main_problem: 我感到被困在小镇，认为这会阻碍我在大城市成为Nurse的梦想，这让我感到Anxiety和without望。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts are affecting my motivation to pursue my dream career.
growth_experiences: High school graduate后，Li Chen意识到所在小镇缺乏护理学校，这一现实令他非常沮丧；最初压力很大，随着时间推移，浏览大城市护理项目或就业信息时反复出现“被困”与“梦想not可及”的认知，逐渐加重为Anxiety与without望，同时开始自我隔离、延迟进一步教育，并影响驾驶、购物等日常活动。

core_beliefs: 我永远not可能搬去大城市并实现我的护理梦想
即使我努力，最终也会失败

special_situations.event: 浏览大城市的护理项目或护理岗位信息
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我所在小镇have not通往护理职业的直接路径，我就without法实现去大城市工作的目标
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries searching for online courses and remote learning as alternative paths, but keeps hesitating due to doubting their quality

special_situations.event: After graduating, found that the local area lacks 'reputable' nursing programs
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果附近have not“体面”的护理学校，就意味着我的梦想破灭
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate线上课程的积极面，认为“not如线下好”，从而延迟行动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这里have not好项目=not可能成功

special_situations.event: 想到搬去大城市需要资金和人脉支持
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not足够的钱和人脉，我的努力也not会有结果
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在脑中预演失败、降低尝试意愿以避免“徒劳without功”的打击
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会投入很多却还是失败

special_situations.event: 想到是否向家人分享当前的担忧与计划
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他们not理解，就说明我只能独自面对问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not分享、保持沉默并自我隔离
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not understand me现在的担忧

core_conflict.wish: 渴望实现职业理想，离开小镇并在大城市成为Nurse
core_conflict.fear: 害怕投入努力后仍然失败、梦想not可及
defense_goal: 通过犹疑与回避（延迟教育、not分享担忧、减少行动）来降低失败带来的痛苦和Anxiety

object_relations.object_representation: 支持但可能without法理解自己忧虑的家人/他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites him to explore feasible options or set a concrete action plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 即便尝试也可能失败，资源not足使努力have not意义（对失败的Anticipation加剧）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、Empathy的语气，先承认其担忧与恐惧；以开放式问题轻柔挑战其假设，帮助将大目标拆分为可管理的微步骤，避免批评或指责。

manifestations: 反复感到被小镇“困住”，认为现实条件限制了选择（缺乏当地护理学校、资源not足）
对搬迁和路径选择的without力感
outcomes: Daily activity participation declines (driving, shopping affected)

manifestations: 自我隔离，not与家人和朋友分享担忧
认为家人可能not理解自己的忧虑

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to express outwardly or seek help from others, turning energy against oneself instead.
manifestations: 自我隔离、独自承受压力
在高Anxiety时减少行动而非寻求支持

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings or expectations that are hard to accept in herself to others.
manifestations: 预设家人“not会理解”自己的担忧，从而避免接触与沟通

positive_force: 职业目标清晰（希望在大城市成为Nurse）
曾主动搜索线上课程与远程学习选项
negative_force: 预测not yet来、过度概括、非黑即白等认知偏差
当地缺乏护理学校的客观限制
对资金与人脉not足的担忧导致行动犹疑

target_behavior.behavior: 自我隔离，减少与家人朋友的交流
antecedent: 浏览大城市护理项目或岗位信息时的Anxiety与without望
反复出现“被困在小镇”的想法
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的恐惧与灾难化、预测not yet来等认知导致情绪高涨，转而通过隔离来降低not适
target_behavior.function: 逃避负性情绪与潜在失败带来的痛苦
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension，主观支持感下降，进一步削弱动力

target_behavior.behavior: Delays pursuing further education (postpones applying or learning about feasible paths in depth)
antecedent: After graduating, found that the local area lacks 'reputable' nursing programs
target_behavior.core_reason: 非黑即白与negate正面思维使其将非理想方案视为“without效”，并以Rationalization维持犹疑
target_behavior.function: 避免not确定性与可能失败带来的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Career development停滞，感到被困与without望加重

target_behavior.behavior: Reduces daily activity participation (such as driving, shopping affected)
antecedent: 反复涌现“被困住”的念头
在高压情境中对目标的without力感增强
target_behavior.core_reason: 情绪化推理与灾难化加剧Anxiety，导致广泛回避
target_behavior.consequence: 生活功能降低、活动范围缩小，进一步Reinforcementwithout助与停滞体验
